# Five Year Vision

> [!question] Prompt
>
> Write in the present tense as if it is five years in the future.
>
> Where do I want to be and how do I want to feel in five years?

## Personal

- Growth
	- How do you want to grow and evolve as a person?
		- I want to be a reliable, resilient person who is an anchor of stability for the people I love.
	- What are the personal qualities, traits, or values that you want to develop or enhance?
		- I want to develop a balance of compassion and resilience
		- I want to be someone who can and does follow through while knowing when it is time to give up.
		- I want to regain a sense of wonder for the world.
	- What are the personal passions, hobbies, or interests that you want to explore or pursue?
		- I want to find these things to balance and reenergize my life.
- Mental Health
	- How do you want to feel and think?
		- I want to feel mentally stable and resilient while expanding my emotional understanding of myself.
		- I want to think openly about new and old issues
	- What are the sources of joy, peace, or satisfaction that you want to experience more of?
		- Happy occasions with friends and family.
		- Personal accomplishments.
	- What are the coping strategies, practices, or resources that you want to use or access to improve your mental well-being and happiness?
		- I want to continue my journaling habits.
		- I want to learn about different interventions for improving my mental health.
- Physical Health
	- How do you want to look and perform?
		- I want to be in good enough shape to play with my nieces and nephews and hopefully a child.
	- What are the health goals or outcomes that you want to achieve or maintain?
		- I want to be able to play with my nieces, nephews, and child without getting tired.
	- What are the lifestyle changes or habits that you want to adopt or sustain to enhance your physical health and fitness?
		- I want to incorporate at least twenty minutes a day of daily movement.
- Education
	- How do you want to learn and grow?
		- Constantly; meaning, I was want to be learning new information or improving my skills.
	- What are the educational or academic goals or opportunities that you want to pursue or complete?
		- I want to have learned all the information in a computer science and data science degree.
	- What are the benefits or rewards that you expect from advancing your education or career?
		- Happiness from overcoming challenges and advancement from new capabilities.
- Financial
	- How do you want to manage and use your money?
		- I want to be able to save enough for me and my family to enjoy life while feeling financially stable.
	- What are the financial goals or milestones that you want to achieve or maintain?
		- Save or invest at least 200 shekels a month.
	- What are the financial habits or behaviors that you want to change or adopt to improve your financial security and freedom?
		- I want to adopt a habit of reviewing my finances and making changes where needed.

## Interpersonal

- Marriage
	- How do you want to relate and connect with your spouse?
		- I want to relate with love, compassion, and understanding.
		- I want to be there for her in times of struggle and want to laugh with her in times of joy.
	- What are the expectations, values, or principles that you and your spouse share or want to establish for your marriage?
		- Mutual support through our different emotions.
	- What are the ways that you want to communicate, support, and respect each other?
- Family
	- How do you want to interact and bond with your parents and siblings?
	- How do you want to interact and bond with your nieces and nephews in the next five years?
		- I want to be a fun uncle who can also listen to them when they need it.
	- What are the activities or events that you want to do or have with your family?
	- What are the memories or stories that you want to preserve or create with your family?
- Friends
	- How do you want to socialize and have fun with your friends?
		- I want to hear about the joy in their life and continue to make good memories together.
	- Who are the friends that you want to keep or make in your life?
		- Noa Sorek and Nadav Halperin
		- Kayla Kalkstein
		- Gonen Rimer
		- Shir Bram
		- Raz Weintraub
		- Noam Tiran
		- Ari Brodkey
		- Micha Stiebel
		- Maor Russo
	- What are the qualities or characteristics that you look for or appreciate in your friends?

## Professional

- Career
	- How do you want to work and succeed?
		- I want to work diligently and with full focus while maintaining a work-life balance.
	- What are the career aspirations, opportunities, or challenges that you want to pursue or face?
	- What are the skills, talents, or achievements that you want to showcase or improve in your field?
